descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B18 · P1 · 已知

很多时间和日期按设备时钟算，没有用服务器时间（违反 UAT 3.8）：「NEW TODAY」、入院日期、体征日期、任务完成时间、转录日期都跟着手机走；手机慢两天时停药被打成两天前，下次清理就把这个药删了

票：TFA-92584 ready for qa（UAT 3.8） · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地

注：根因已知（Daniela 10-03 提过要用服务器时间）；删药、掉标签、草稿恢复错这几个症状是新的

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-01/S08, TC-10/S22, TC-12/S23, TC-19/S19, TC-22/S23, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28, TC-16/S25

思路 / Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S24a 「时钟快一天、在另一个时区的手机 context：徽章、第几天、记录日期和「today」都和电脑一样」 Phone context a day ahead in another time zone: same badge, day, note date and 'today' as the computer

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Time-based state uses the server clock: a device with a wrong clock, no clock set or another time zone shows the same state as the other device (badge after the day roll, hospital day / visit number, …（UAT 3.8；TFA-92584 AC 8）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Computer context on the real clock; phone context with timezoneId 'Pacific/Honolulu' and page.clock set one day ahead. {hospitalPatient} set to New Admission on the server's yesterday; the Nursing Home run uses {snfResident}'s visit number

When Both open the list and the chart; the phone types an encounter line and taps Generate Note & Finish once

Then Both screens show the same badge (rolled to Follow-up once), the same hospital day / visit number and the same note date. The stored transcriptDate is the server's date, and on the computer today's encounter is not listed as a prior transcript

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Scripted: badge, hospital day / visit number and note date read from both pages must be equal; the stored transcriptDate (read-only adminQuery) must equal the server's date (UAT 3.8: time-based state uses the server clock); on the computer the encounter must not appear among prior transcripts (3.6: prior transcripts show today and yesterday only). …

在哪跑：本地 probes（多端探针）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S24a 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-25.matrix.json 里的编号；字母后缀 = 一个用例拆成了几条），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92584 ready for qa

同一个医院病人，电脑上显示「New today」，时钟快一天的手机上却不显示，因为徽章是每台设备按自己的时钟算的。

The same Hospital patient shows 'New today' on the computer but not on a phone whose clock is a day ahead, because each device decides the badge from its own clock.

依据：allure-results/f6b92cfc…: a phone in Pacific/Honolulu, one day ahead, vs a computer on the real clock. The Hospital card shows 'NEW TODAY' on the computer but not on the phone; headers and NH are equal. The note-date checks need Generate (not run). TC-25 knownGap TFA-92584 AC 8 (the day roll follows the device clock).

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane probes。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：probes。

怎么测（probes/plan.json，automatable: yes）：sync-probe both modes: phone context timezoneId Pacific/Honolulu + page.clock one day ahead, signs in on that device; chart seeded New Admission on the server's yesterday; compare card text, chart header, note date after one LIVE Generate on the phone; stored transcriptDate vs server date; computer must not list today's encounter as prior. [Review 2026-10-14] Failed on cells that ran; Generate cells gated and labelled partial; patch carries partial.needs = ['generate']. — device-clock + multi-session in Playwright; known TFA-92584 AC 8 if it differs.

Detail:

Failed on a cell that ran; partial — the Generate cells (note date, transcriptDate, prior transcripts) NOT RUN. Phone in Pacific/Honolulu with its clock one day ahead (signed in on that device) vs computer on the real clock, chart set New Admission on the server's yesterday (both show Follow-up): the Hospital card on the computer shows 'NEW TODAY', the phone's does not; chart headers equal; NH equal. Generate / Regenerate is forbidden on the local target (scripts/capabilities.json, Quinn 2026-10-13); those cells run only with QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1.

产品问题：Known TFA-92584 AC 8: the same Hospital patient shows 'New today' on the computer but not on a phone whose clock is a day ahead (the badge is decided by each device's clock).

已知缺口（known）：TFA-92584 AC 8

证据：附了 3 个。
